# Subway Seat wallpapers

Two flat scenes in each flavor: the supergraphic stripes on walnut paneling, and a row of orange and gold bucket seats under the tunnel lights. SVGs at 16:9, 16:10 and phone size; PNGs at 5K, 4K, 2560×1600 and 1290×2796 are in assets/wallpapers. macOS needs a PNG.

[Wallpapers](https://github.com/oddurs/subway-seat/tree/main/assets/wallpapers) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/wallpapers/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in a shell (GNOME or KDE Plasma):

```sh
# GNOME
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.background picture-uri "file://$HOME/Pictures/Subway Seat/subway-seat-stripes-16x10.svg"
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.background picture-uri-dark "file://$HOME/Pictures/Subway Seat/subway-seat-stripes-16x10.svg"
# KDE Plasma
plasma-apply-wallpaperimage "$HOME/Pictures/Subway Seat/subway-seat-stripes-16x10.svg"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in a shell (GNOME or KDE Plasma):

```sh
# GNOME
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.background picture-uri "file://$HOME/Pictures/Subway Seat/subway-seat-tunnel-stripes-16x10.svg"
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.background picture-uri-dark "file://$HOME/Pictures/Subway Seat/subway-seat-tunnel-stripes-16x10.svg"
# KDE Plasma
plasma-apply-wallpaperimage "$HOME/Pictures/Subway Seat/subway-seat-tunnel-stripes-16x10.svg"
```

## Follow light and dark

In a shell (GNOME keeps a light and a dark picture):

```sh
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.background picture-uri "file://$HOME/Pictures/Subway Seat/subway-seat-enamel-stripes-16x10.svg"
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.background picture-uri-dark "file://$HOME/Pictures/Subway Seat/subway-seat-stripes-16x10.svg"
```
